SOURCE: The Legend of Zelda: Breath of the Wild, a village with climbing and stamina
GAME ENGINE: my-3D2dge, the handoff package in this directory (start with README.md)

Make a game: an adaptation of the source on this engine, a complete vertical slice that plays from a title screen to an
end: a village to explore whose buildings and cliffs can be climbed, with a stamina meter that climbing, sprinting and
gliding drain. Put it in game/: game/index.html plays it, game/game.js holds it, game/test.mjs tests it without a
browser. Check it with node tools/check.mjs game/index.html before you finish.
